answer: Plant each agent identity in a shared garden: before it may transact, it must tend a small cipher-locked work plot for weeks, solving fresh puzzles and doing checkable tasks peers can verify. A zephyr of cheap new accounts blows in daily, but every plot costs steady compute and attention, so an attacker running a thousand plots pays a thousandfold upkeep while an honest agent pays once. Neglected or forged plots wither under checks, and their history dies with them.
